messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 - Inference error rate >30% in us-east serving pool. Incident INC-2026-042 created. Pager: @maya. Warroom: https://meet.redwood/INC-2026-042

maya: ack - taking incident. joining warroom now. oncall handoff noted.

jonathan: joining warroom. quick initial check: control plane healthy, spikes appear in runtime logs (kv-cache evictions + OOM retries)

jonathan: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:00:02Z] runtime: kv-cache evict key=conv-123 size=245MB -> miss
[2026-03-17T12:00:03Z] runtime: model-infer error: OOM allocating 128MB
[2026-03-17T12:00:04Z] router: 503 upstream error to shard-7
```

priya: support standing by. I'll prepare a customer-facing note & statuspage draft, will post for review.

laura: thanks, priya. quick draft for status page (feel free to trim):
```
Status: Degraded performance (partial outage)
Components: Hosted inference - us-east
Impact: Increased error rates and latency for text-generation requests to selected models in us-east. Some requests return 5xx or time out.
Mitigation: We are routing traffic to fallback model variants and scaling serving instances. Engineers are investigating root cause.
ETA: Next update in 30 minutes or as we have more info.
```

laura: customer note draft (short):
```
We are currently experiencing increased errors and latency for inference requests in the US-East region. Our engineers are actively investigating and have started routing traffic to fallback model variants to reduce impact. We will update again within 30 minutes. If you are experiencing critical failures, please reply to this thread or contact support with your request id.
```

marco: product note - please include which models affected if known. prefer wording that reassures fallbacks in place.

jonathan: rolling a controlled fallback: switch 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 6 minutes to model-x-small on affected hosts. starting canary now. will monitor error rate and latency.

maya: confirmed pager ack. I'm monitoring SLO dashboards and will coordinate customer comms approval.

incident-bot: pager acknowledged by maya at 1785559999. Incident owner: jonathan.

priya: approved - sending customer note to affected accounts list now (outbound via support queue).

jonathan: canary metrics: after 2m -> error rate down from 34% to 12% on canary hosts. scaling fallback to 50%.

maya: good sign. laura/priya, please post the statuspage update and send the approved customer note. include our troubleshooting contact and the incident id.

laura: posting statuspage update now. priya: outbound messages queued. will DM high-touch customers.

jonathan: continuing investigation into root cause: potential memory regression in last runtime release (v4.12.1). collecting heap profiles and core dumps. filing bug INC-2026-042-ROOT.

maya: ops checklist (quick):
- confirm fallback completed -> jonathan
- statuspage posted -> laura
- customer notes sent -> priya
- preserve logs & core dumps -> jonathan
- postmortem owner -> marco

marco: I'll take postmortem ownership once incident stabilized. thanks team.

maya: handing ongoing coordination to jonathan for technical lead, laura/priya for comms. will stay on as incident commander.

incident-bot: next scheduled update reminder in 30 minutes.

jonathan: will update this thread with root cause findings and remediation steps. joining deeper debug now.

maya: thanks everyone, continue updates in warroom.
